title: Bamnang Holdings
tagline: Empowering students through bilingual conversational AI & career intelligence.
summary: Architected bilingual multi-agent AI chatbot (PiPi) and the end-to-end backend for the Major Compass Test (MCT) recommendation engine.
story: At Bamnang, students often struggle to discover the right university major because educational resources were scattered across multiple platforms and languages. I architected and built the end-to-end backend for the Major Recommendation Engine (Major Compass Test - MCT), translating psychological assessment models and student questionnaires into data-driven career recommendations. In parallel, I developed PiPi, a bilingual multi-agent AI chatbot capable of seamlessly understanding queries in English, Khmer, and Khmer Latin to provide instant answers on universities, scholarships, and academic pathways with 98% accuracy.
highlights: Designed and deployed the Major Recommendation Engine (MCT) scoring algorithms and backend APIs.
Engineered a bilingual Multi-Agent RAG system handling Khmer script, Khmer Latin, and English queries.
Built the Bamnang User Intelligence executive dashboard utilizing PostgreSQL, PGVector, and Metabase.

title: Ministry of Economy & Finance
tagline: Unlocking macroeconomic publications from scanned PDFs into analytics-ready tidy data.
summary: Engineered automated document table extraction using Datalab/Marker and an LLM-assisted cleaning pipeline following Hadley Wickham's Tidy Data principles.
story: Crucial macroeconomic reports and public sector budgets are often published as locked scanned PDFs and complex tables with merged headers. At the Ministry of Economy and Finance, I engineered an automated, modern Document Extraction system leveraging Datalab/Marker to extract tabular structures and text from scanned PDF reports. To solve structural anomalies, I designed a pipeline powered by LLM services to clean, normalize, and validate messy extracted outputs into structured datasets based on Hadley Wickham’s Tidy Data principles, saving days of manual transcription work.
highlights: Engineered automated modern OCR table extraction pipeline converting complex PDF reports to structured data.
Implemented LLM validation pipelines to resolve merged headers, footnotes, and multi-currency formats.
Standardized macroeconomic data workflows according to Tidy Data principles for downstream economic modeling.

title: Python Trainer
tagline: Demystifying programming fundamentals and empowering learners to build real tools.
summary: Authored comprehensive beginner-friendly Python curricula, lecture slide decks, and hands-on weekend coding workshops.
story: Believing that programming literacy should be welcoming rather than intimidating, I authored a practical, beginner-friendly Python training program for community members and aspiring developers. I designed structured slide decks and real-world exercises covering syntax, conditional logic, loops, functions, and file handling. During weekly workshops, I guided students through building their own automation scripts, debugging challenges, and discovering the joy of problem-solving with Python.
highlights: Authored 10+ comprehensive training slide decks and practical weekend coding exercises.
Trained and mentored 40+ enthusiastic learners with zero prior coding background.
Guided students through writing automation scripts, data parsers, and web scraping prototypes.

title: YES Leader
tagline: Igniting young imaginations through Scratch block-based visual programming.
summary: Coordinated volunteer trainers to teach Scratch programming at PTEC, honored with Certificate of Honor by the PTEC Director.
story: As Volunteer Coordinator for Youth Empowering Society (YES), I led a vibrant team of volunteer trainers delivering weekend programming workshops for young students at the Phnom Penh Teacher Education College (PTEC). We created a playful curriculum using Scratch, introducing computational thinking, logic branching, and game design. Watching students with no prior computer access proudly present their own animated stories and games was deeply inspiring. Our team's dedication and social impact were officially recognized with a Certificate of Honor from the PTEC Director.
highlights: Coordinated a team of 10+ volunteer trainers conducting weekly hands-on programming labs.
Designed visual Scratch lessons introducing loops, variables, and event-driven interactivity.
Awarded Certificate of Honor from PTEC Director for outstanding volunteer leadership.

title: AWS Cloud Journey
tagline: Building scalable, resilient serverless backends and automated AI pipelines in the cloud.
summary: Architected serverless microservices with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and DynamoDB for high-availability AI deployment.
story: Recognizing that impactful AI models and data pipelines require dependable, production-grade cloud infrastructure, I embarked on a deep AWS cloud architecture journey. I designed serverless event-driven backends using AWS Lambda and API Gateway, configured scalable S3 buckets for large dataset extraction, and implemented secure IAM role configurations. This cloud expertise guarantees that data solutions run reliably with automated scaling, sub-50ms latency, and high availability.
highlights: Architected serverless microservice pipelines utilizing AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Amazon S3.
Implemented cloud security best practices with fine-grained IAM policies and CloudWatch logging.
Optimized document extraction and retrieval latency for AI applications in the cloud.

title: Youth & Their Future Career Talk
organization: IFL Final Project · Funded by YRDP
tagline: Empowering Grade 11 high school students through a youth-led career panel discussion and guidance initiative.
summary: Led a 6-member team to secure grant funding from YRDP and organize a comprehensive career orientation panel at Indratevi High School.
story: For our Institute of Foreign Languages (IFL) final project, I served as Team Leader directing a 6-member team in conceptualizing, fundraising, and executing the 'Youth and Their Future Career Talk'. We drafted and successfully defended a formal grant proposal to the Youth Resource Development Program (YRDP) to secure project sponsorship. Coordinating with Indratevi High School administration, we hosted an impactful career panel session for Grade 11 students. We invited inspiring guest speakers and industry practitioners across diverse sectors, facilitating an engaging dialogue that equipped high schoolers with essential criteria, self-awareness frameworks, and practical keys for selecting university majors and future careers.
highlights: Led a 6-member team to draft, pitch, and secure grant funding from YRDP (Youth Resource Development Program).
Coordinated with Indratevi High School to deliver an interactive career orientation talk for Grade 11 students.
Curated and moderated a panel of guest speakers sharing practical guidance on academic and career pathways.
